title: The compact-support coefficient square for open and closed factorizations
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B, and X,V,P,S Noetherian schemes. Let f:X→S and p:P→S be separated quasi-compact locally finite-type compactifiable maps, j:V→X a quasi-compact open immersion, and i:V→P a closed immersion, with j≫f=i≫p. Write F_f,R and F_p,R for the chosen ordinary etale compact-support functors, J_R=Ri_*, and E_R=j_! for exact extension by zero. Let Q_T be scalar extension, c_f and c_p the canonical compact-support coefficient maps, d_i the canonical proper scalarMate, and o_j the canonical openIso [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations, def-per-exceptional-coefficient-maps, lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence]. For every bounded constructible finite-Tor W in D(X_et,A), put L=j^*W [def-kun-tor-amplitude, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. There exist natural isomorphisms t_R:E_R⋙F_f,R≅J_R⋙F_p,R for R=A,B such that Q_S(t_A,L)≫c_p,J_A(L)≫F_p,B(d_i,L)=c_f,E_A(L)≫F_f,B(o_j,L)≫t_B,Q_V(L). This statement concerns only the left adjoints; it asserts neither invertibility nor any equality of exceptional coefficient maps.

source.place: paragraphs 2--3, normalized counit and factorization comparison

proof.text: Use exact open inverse image on the bounded constructible W. Translate between the finite-value and source-library constructibility predicates, and use exact-flat functor transport of a flat model to restrict its Tor interval. Apply the existing scalar flat-model calculation to this restricted complex. It and its scalar extension are therefore bounded below; these are exactly the two inputs required by compactScalar refinement and composition coherence. The Lean proof reuses the proved sourceBoundedConstructible, finiteValueBoundedConstructible, exactFlatFunctor_tor and scalarBoundedConstructibleTor helpers from CoefficientDualizingOpenTensor.

For the special open compactification (j,identity), naturality of the canonical identity direct-image isomorphism and scalarMate_directImage_identity identify its coefficient map with openIso. For the special proper compactification (identity,i), naturality of scalarMate and etale_scalar_id identify its coefficient map with scalarMate at i. The latter identity uses compactScalarOpen_eq to replace openScalarExtension by the published openIso.

Transport both special normalizations to the chosen compactifications using compactScalar_compactification_comparison on L and QL. Invert the compactification square by cancellation of its isomorphisms. This gives chosen_open_scalar and chosen_proper_scalar, with the two normalizations constructed explicitly from rightDerivedLowerShriekIso and the identity functor isomorphisms.

Whisker the inverse open or proper normalization by structural compact support, and compose with unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso for j,f or i,p. Apply etaleCompactScalarComposition, naturality of the outer coefficient map, and the preceding normalization squares. The fully proved generic normalized_composition_scalar lemma performs this pasting.

Transport chosen compact support along h:j≫f=i≫p; by equality induction its scalar square commutes. Define tR to be the open normalized compositor, this equality comparison, and the inverse closed normalized compositor. Invert the closed scalar square, then paste it with the equality and open squares. Associativity and functoriality yield exactly the required equation.

lean.statement:
theorem openClosedCompactScalar_coherence
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X V P S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian V] [IsNoetherian P] [IsNoetherian S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification f]
    (j : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (i : V ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (p : P ⟶ S) [IsSeparated p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    [HasCompactification p] (h : j ≫ f = i ≫ p)
    (W : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (hW : DerivedCategory.isBoundedConstructible A X W ∧
      ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn A X a b W) :
    ∃ (tA : derivedExtension (A := A) j ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅
        rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
      (tB : derivedExtension (A := B) j ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f ≅
        rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) i ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) p),
      let L := (derivedRestriction (A := A) j).obj W
      (scalarExtension φ S).map (tA.hom.app L) ≫
          (compactScalarChosenMap φ p).app
            ((rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj L) ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) p).map
            ((scalarMate φ i).app L) =
        (compactScalarChosenMap φ f).app ((derivedExtension (A := A) j).obj L) ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).map
            ((ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso φ j).hom.app L) ≫
          tB.hom.app ((scalarExtension φ V).obj L)
